title: Color Mayhem
description: Add-on for IoB and AA adding more variants to collect!
body:
Welcome to color mayhem! a resource pack adding more variants to the species added by IoB and AA, this is a pack made for fun for those who want more wild and named variants in their dragon worlds!



This requires the following mods:

Isle of Berk
Archipelago Addititons
Isle of Berk Variant Loader
